---
title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv")
print(mallards, n = 10)
```

```{r}
# Count rows per duck, sorted from most to least fixes
mallards |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Summarize minimum and maximum latitude and longitude
mallards |>
  summarize(
    min_lat = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lat = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_long = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_long = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv") |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = as_datetime(timestamp),
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    # Group numeric months into seasons, then order levels chronologically
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter"))
  )

# Save the processed tibble (preserving factor levels) for other pages
write_rds(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
# Load country borders as sf polygons
europe <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Filter GPS fixes to the region of interest
mallards_roi <- mallards |>
  filter(between(lat, 47, 55), between(long, 8, 25))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = europe, fill = "gray95", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Hide the legend since 52 duck IDs would crowd out the map
  geom_point(
    data = mallards_roi,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    size = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(8, 25), ylim = c(47, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS Fixes Across Central and Eastern Europe",
    subtitle = "83,271 tracking locations from 52 individual mallards",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
